# GitHub Copilot Instructions — Alimango AI Governance Lab

Treat `AGENTS.md` as the repository agent entry point and `.specify/memory/constitution.md` as the highest repo-local authority.

Keep all suggestions public-safe and self-contained. Do not introduce secrets, personal/customer data, confidential source, non-public endpoints, proprietary implementation details, or references to non-public projects, repositories, deployments, infrastructure, or organizational relationships.

For behavior-changing work, follow Spec Kit, capability/action governance, evidence, independent review when material, Unlazy, and convergence. Tool availability is not authorization.
